tokens.name: Abomination
tokens.text: Slowpoke. Its Power and Guard are determined separately when it is created.
tokens.rule: When an Abomination is created, roll the designated Power die, then the designated Guard die. Its Power equals the Power result and its Guard equals the Guard result. If dedicated dice are unavailable, roll one d6 twice: the first roll is Power and the second roll is Guard. The player never chooses which result applies to which stat. An Abomination entering play follows normal Character entry rules and cannot Attack that Turn unless another effect grants Hothead.
tokens.purpose: An unstable experiment whose offensive and defensive results are independently randomized.

tokens.name: Specimen
tokens.rule: A Specimen may be represented by an approved external TCG card. Its original game's text, stats, cost, color, rarity, abilities, and rules have no effect in Unhinged. If a physical external card representing a Specimen leaves play, set it aside as used instead of putting it in an Unhinged zone.
tokens.purpose: Preserves the visual gag of cross-TCG cards without importing another game's rules engine.
